title: Kavi Kuyil
desc: Gopal and Radha deeply love each other, but an accident makes Gopal lose his memory. Pregnant Radha waits patiently while Murugan faces Lakshmi's unrequited love.

title: Vijaya
desc: Vijay, carefree, hires Selvam from a senior home to pretend to be his father for business deal. Over time, they help each other and grow.

title: Thendral Varum Theru
desc: Ravi and Kumar chase dreams while Meena, a hostel worker, heals from past hurts. Their intertwined lives explore friendship, love, perseverance, sacrifices, and finding happiness.
